purpose: Choose the forecast model and uncertainty method on development data only; evaluate once on later data.
walk_forward: models refit on the first day of each month using only rows whose target date is earlier; first forecasts 2023-03-01
development_window: target dates 2023-09-01 to 2024-12-31 (488 days) in six chronological blocks; the ONLY data used to choose the model or the uncertainty method
known_benchmark: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (365 days). Version 1 of this project had already examined 2025, so it is reported but never used for any choice.
new_holdout: 2026-01-01 to 2026-02-18 (49 days). Not used by version 1 or by any choice here; evaluated after the selection was written to results/selection_frozen.json.
candidates: 11 forecasts: persistence, 7-day mean, seasonal climatology, persistence/climatology blend, 5 ridge variants (one on log scale), boosted stumps
model_rule: lowest pooled development MAE among the fitted (non-baseline) candidates
uncertainty_candidates: all-past absolute errors (v1 style), all-past signed errors, trailing 90 days, trailing 180 days, by forecast level (terciles), relative log-scale errors
uncertainty_rule: lowest mean over development blocks (>=25 days) of |coverage - 0.80|; ties broken by narrower interval
warning_rule: forecast plus the c/(c+1) quantile of earlier errors under the chosen uncertainty method; same procedure applied to persistence
primary_decision_setting: threshold 55 ug/m3, missed high day costs 3x a false alarm (illustrative, fixed in advance; 35/100 and 1x/5x are sensitivity checks)
statistics: paired circular moving-block bootstrap, 7-day blocks, 2000 resamples, seed 26080; intervals are descriptive and uncorrected for the many comparisons shown
test_that_enforces_it: test_integrity.py re-runs the development stage with all 2025-2026 data deleted and requires an identical selection hash
